SELECT , -- 招采项目基础信息 br.release_date, -- 最新发布日期 br.bid_deadline, -- 最新投标截止时间 br.bid_opening_time, -- 最新开标时间 br.round, -- 最新轮次 bs.name projectTypeName, -- 项目类型名称 ifnull(COUNT(DISTINCT pts.id),0) respondNum, -- 应标单位数量 ifnull(COUNT(DISTINCT os.supplier_id),0) tickSizeNum -- 当前轮次报价单位数量 FROM project_tendering pt LEFT JOIN subject bs ON bs.id = pt.project_type LEFT JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN project_tendering_supplier pts ON pts.project_tendering_id = pt.id AND pts.bid_status = 1 LEFT JOIN bidding_supplier bsr on bsr.supplier_id = pts.bid_supplier_id LEFT JOIN offer_rounds os ON os.supplier_id = pts.`id` AND os.project_tendering_id = pt.`id` AND os.bid_gross_amount IS NOT NULL and os.offer_round = br.round AND os.is_hold = 0 WHERE pt.UUID = #{uuid} and br.round = (SELECT MAX(ROUND) FROM bidding_rounds WHERE project_id = pt.id ) -- 应标中的列表
AND pt.status = 2 -- 审核通过 AND br.round = 1 -- 最新招标轮次 AND pt.is_open = 0 -- 是否开标 AND pt.project_progress != 5 AND pt.project_progress != 6 -- 项目进度不为结束和废标 -- 投标截止时间筛选
AND date(br.bid_deadline) >= date(#{startDate})
AND date(br.bid_deadline) <= date(#{endDate})
-- 开标中的列表
AND pt.status = 2 -- 审核通过 AND pt.is_open = 1 -- 是否开标 AND pt.project_progress != 5 AND pt.project_progress != 6 -- 项目进度不为结束和废标 -- 投标截止时间筛选
AND date(br.bid_deadline) >= date(#{startDate})
AND date(br.bid_deadline) <= date(#{endDate})
-- 开标时间筛选
AND date(br.bid_opening_time) >= date(#{startDateVerifier})
AND date(br.bid_opening_time) <= date(#{endDateVerifier})
-- 已结束和废弃的列表
AND pt.status = 2 -- 审核通过 AND pt.project_progress in (5,6) -- 项目进度为结束和废标 -- 发布时间筛选
AND date(br.release_date) >= date(#{startDate})
AND date(br.release_date) <= date(#{endDate})
-- 其他参数
AND pt.contract_no like concat('%',#{dto.contractNo},'%')
AND bsr.name like concat('%',#{dto.biddingUnit},'%')
AND pt.name like concat('%',#{dto.name},'%')
AND pt.user_name like concat('%',#{dto.founder},'%')
AND pt.verifier_name like concat('%',#{dto.verifier},'%')
AND pt.project_type = #{dto.projectType}
AND pt.bidding_type = #{dto.biddingType}
AND pt.project_progress = #{dto.projectProgress}
AND pt.status = #{dto.status}
AND date(pt.verifier_time) >= date(#{startDateVerifier})
AND date(pt.verifier_time) <= date(#{endDateVerifier})
AND date(pt.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
AND date(pt.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
GROUP BY pt.id,br.release_date,br.bid_deadline,br.bid_opening_time,br.round,bs.name ORDER BY pt.project_progress ASC,pt.create_time DESC

SELECT pt.id, -- 项目id br.release_date, -- 最新发布日期 br.bid_deadline, -- 最新投标截止时间 br.bid_opening_time, -- 最新开标时间 br.round, -- 最新轮次 ifnull(COUNT(DISTINCT os.supplier_id),0) tickSizeNum -- 当前轮次报价单位数量 FROM project_tendering pt LEFT JOIN subject bs ON bs.id = pt.project_type LEFT JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN project_tendering_supplier pts ON pts.project_tendering_id = pt.id AND pts.bid_status = 1 LEFT JOIN offer_rounds os ON os.supplier_id = pts.`id` AND os.project_tendering_id = pt.`id` AND os.bid_gross_amount IS NOT NULL AND os.offer_round = br.round AND os.is_hold = 0 WHERE pt.UUID = #{UUID} and br.round = (SELECT MAX(ROUND) FROM bidding_rounds WHERE project_id = pt.id ) AND pt.project_progress != 4 AND pt.`status` = 2 GROUP BY pt.id,br.release_date,br.bid_deadline,br.bid_opening_time,br.round

FROM project_tendering pt INNER JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = pt.id WHERE pt.UUID = #{UUID} and pt.`status` = 2 AND pt.project_progress = 2 and pt.bidding_type = 0 GROUP BY br.id HAVING MAX(br.`round`) = 1

SELECT , -- 招采项目的基础信息 br.release_date, -- 最新发布日期 br.bid_deadline, -- 最新投标截止时间 br.bid_opening_time, -- 最新开标时间 br.round, -- 最新轮次 br.id AS roundId, -- 最新轮次的id bs.name projectTypeName, -- 招采项目类型名称 IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT pts.id),0) respondNum, -- 应标单位数量 IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT os.supplier_id),0) tickSizeNum -- 报价单位数量 FROM project_tendering pt LEFT JOIN subject bs ON bs.id = pt.project_type LEFT JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN project_tendering_supplier pts ON pts.project_tendering_id = pt.id AND pts.bid_status = 1 LEFT JOIN offer_rounds os ON os.supplier_id = pts.`id` AND os.project_tendering_id = pt.`id` AND os.bid_gross_amount IS NOT NULL WHERE br.round = (SELECT MAX(ROUND) FROM bidding_rounds WHERE project_id = pt.id ) AND pt.id = #{id} GROUP BY pt.id,br.release_date,br.bid_deadline,br.bid_opening_time,br.id,bs.name

SELECT SUM(IFNULL(ods.bid_amount,0)) AS totalAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.id) AS quantity, pt.`project_type` AS projectType, bs.name AS typeName FROM project_tendering pt LEFT JOIN subject bs ON bs.id = pt.`project_type` LEFT JOIN bidding_rounds br ON br.project_id = pt.id AND br.round = (SELECT MAX(ROUND) FROM bidding_rounds WHERE project_id = pt.id) LEFT JOIN project_tendering_supplier pts ON pts.project_tendering_id = pt.id AND pts.bid_status = 1 LEFT JOIN offer_rounds os ON os.supplier_id = pts.`id` AND os.project_tendering_id = pt.`id` AND os.`offer_round` = br.`round` LEFT JOIN offer_round_detail ods on ods.offer_id = os.id AND ods.is_follow = 1 and ods.project_id = pt.id
AND pt.UUID = #{uuid}
AND date(pt.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
AND date(pt.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
GROUP BY pt.`project_type`,bs.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
